name: ApiFreeLLM
description: Community sandbox that hands out a free key for a single hosted model.
overview: ApiFreeLLM splits its service in two: a Community Best-Effort sandbox that is free and a credit-based Managed path that is not. The free tier needs only a Google sign-in, takes 50 requests a day with an 8,000-token input ceiling, and answers through a single model with no reliability guarantee — its own dashboard reported 74.5% success and roughly 25 tokens/second over a recent 24 hours. The endpoint takes `message` rather than `messages`, so the OpenAI SDKs cannot be pointed at it.
free_access: Best-effort sandbox; OpenAI-compatible endpoint is paid-only
notes: Custom request schema (message, not messages) and roughly 75% success in the vendor's own metrics.
